Common.tagline: Elegant digital invitations for your occasions

Landing.title: Da3wety — digital invitations for weddings and occasions
Landing.description: Create your event page, send the invitation on WhatsApp, and track guest replies in one place.

hero.title: A digital invitation worthy of your celebration
hero.subtitle: An envelope that opens, a photo that is revealed, and RSVPs that reach you instantly — all from one link you share on WhatsApp.
hero.trust: No app to install · Works on any phone · Arabic and English

features.title: More than a card
features.subtitle: Each invitation is a small experience for your guests and a control room for you.

envelope.title: An envelope that opens
envelope.body: Guests tap to open a sealed envelope and scratch to reveal your photo.

rsvp.title: RSVPs with seats
rsvp.body: Guests confirm, choose their seats and leave a wish. You see it instantly.

whatsapp.title: Share on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: One public link, or a personal link per guest, with ready-made reminders.

tickets.title: QR tickets
tickets.body: Every confirmed guest gets a ticket with a QR code and a short code.

gallery.title: Shared photo gallery
gallery.body: Guests upload their photos to one gallery you can moderate. Kept for a week.

checkin.title: Door check-in
checkin.body: Your staff scan tickets at the door from any phone. Live attendance counts.

howItWorks.title: From idea to invitation in minutes

create.title: Create your event
create.body: Names, date, place, a photo and the colours you like.

share.title: Share the link
share.body: Send the public link or a personal link to each guest on WhatsApp.

track.title: Track replies
track.body: Watch RSVPs, wishes and seats come in. Remind those who haven't answered.

themes.title: Pick the colours of your day

pricing.title: One price per event
pricing.subtitle: Pay once for your occasion. Packages are activated after sign-up.
pricing.note: Prices shown are launch prices. Need something custom? Message us on WhatsApp.

app.q: Do my guests need an app?
app.a: No. The invitation is a web page that opens in any browser on any phone.

whatsapp.q: How do I send the invitation?
whatsapp.a: Copy the link from your dashboard and share it on WhatsApp, or send each guest their personal link.

edit.q: Can I change the invitation after sending it?
edit.a: Yes. The link stays the same; guests always see the latest version.

photos.q: How long are gallery photos kept?
photos.a: Seven days after the event, then they are deleted automatically.

payment.a: Sign in, create your event, then message us on WhatsApp to activate your package.

ctaBand.title: Your celebration deserves a beautiful invitation
ctaBand.subtitle: Create it in minutes, share it in seconds.
